title: The one part of the thesis that survives intact: one answer to one question is learned, permanent, and carries to a new file
the_first_principles_move: r55-r57 made the system refuse a tie and ask. That is correct and, on its own, a regression in usefulness: the same user is asked the same question forever. An asked-and-answered ambiguity is not ambiguous any more. The missing component was memory keyed by the PHRASE rather than by the document.

the_measurement.second_ask_same_file: ANSWERED -> ['q','z'], reporting which clarification it used
the_measurement.scoped_correctly: a different phrasing does not inherit the choice

why_this_is_the_thesis_working: the standing claim is 'teach it once and it has it permanently, in new environments'. Here a clarification -- one turn, one choice -- is learned, persisted in sqlite, applied to the same phrasing on a file the system has never seen, and it survives restart like every other row. This is the only place in fifty-eight rounds where the claim's shape and the measurement agree without qualification.

what_it_is_not.not_zero_shot: it still cannot act on a phrasing it has never been taught or asked about
what_it_is_not.not_a_semantic_parser: the phrase key is a sorted word set with the operand stripped; 'dedupe the lines in' and 'dedupe lines in' collide, and so do their negatives
what_it_is_not.not_a_model: 0 parameters. It remembers a choice; it does not understand one.

transfer_requires_the_phrase: the carry to a new file works because the key drops the operand. It does NOT carry to a paraphrase: taught 'dedupe the lines in', the system will still ask about 'remove duplicates from'. That boundary is the same information ceiling measured in r55, moved one level up: what is learned is a phrase-to-operation binding, not a concept.

external_agreement_2026.When RAG Users Ask Vague Questions: 'the conversation does not carry the clarification across turns; the learned default carries it across requests' -- and 'without the learned-default table, silent inference is just guessing'
external_agreement_2026.ReferClaw (arXiv 2611.07683): bounded clarification turns; 'learns from verified interaction feedback so that disambiguation mistakes are not repeated'
external_agreement_2026.PAHF (arXiv 2602.16173): pre-action clarification plus a persistent preference memory; asking before acting beats post-action correction at the first interaction

where_this_deliberately_diverges: those systems learn a default for a missing FIELD and apply it silently inside a confidence band. This learns which of several TAUGHT OPERATIONS a repeated PHRASE means, with no confidence band and no threshold: one answer, one phrase, no other. The memory decides WHICH skill; the carrier still executes it and the postcondition still verifies it, so a remembered choice that cannot verify falls back to asking rather than returning an answer.
honest_scope: this closes one seam. It does not touch ranks 1-5 of the r56 ranking: there is still no model, no desktop, no planner, no discovery, and the horizon wall is unchanged. A system that remembers which `wc` you meant is a better filing cabinet, not an agent.
